principles: Default-deny every data flow not enumerated here.
Tenant and principal identity remain explicit at every persisted authority boundary.
Secrets are references or externally custodied key material, never telemetry fields.
Source evidence establishes implementation intent, not live residency, retention, encryption, deletion, or legal-subprocessor performance.

classifications.public_system: Non-customer product metadata intended for broad disclosure.
classifications.sensitive_identity: Identifiers, roles, session metadata, and authorization context.
classifications.restricted_customer_content: Prompts, goals, conversation text, source files, results, and customer business records.
classifications.restricted_secret: Passwords, bearer credentials, private keys, wrapped keys, and provider secrets.
classifications.sensitive_operational: Availability, capacity, spend, quota, and pseudonymous correlation telemetry.
classifications.integrity_evidence: Signed audit, approval, receipt, and evidence records that may contain customer identifiers or bounded content summaries.

data_flows.purpose: Authenticate a human principal and enforce tenant-scoped RBAC.
data_flows.tenant_boundary: Exact principal-to-tenant grant and Postgres RLS; no static operator-token fallback.
data_flows.retention: Deployment-approved identity and session schedule required; no repository claim of automatic expiry beyond protocol/session controls.
data_flows.encryption_in_transit: TLS is required at ingress and database transport; live certificate and route proof required.
data_flows.encryption_at_rest: Postgres/platform encryption is deployment-owned; session secrets are externally injected.
data_flows.deletion: Tenant/client lifecycle workflows plus identity-provider deprovisioning; live residual scan required.

data_flows.purpose: Plan and execute governed customer goals and return results.
data_flows.tenant_boundary: Principal-isolated tenancy plus Postgres RLS and tenant-bound dispatch.
data_flows.retention: Customer-approved schedule required; feature:automated-retention is excluded from this profile.
data_flows.encryption_in_transit: TLS to browser, Postgres, and vLLM; live network and certificate proof required.
data_flows.encryption_at_rest: Deployment-owned Postgres and volume encryption; no source-only claim of provider encryption.
access: approved support access under incident procedure
data_flows.deletion: Reviewed tenant/client export and erasure workflow; live backup and replica residual proof required.

data_flows.purpose: Persist flow definitions, run state, checkpoints, approvals, leases, and deterministic resume state.
data_flows.tenant_boundary: Tenant-pinned flow/run authority and Postgres RLS.
data_flows.retention: Customer-approved schedule required; resume and receipt dependencies must be honored before purge.
access: migration owner only during drained lifecycle
data_flows.deletion: Tenant/client lifecycle workflow with referential and residual verification.

data_flows.purpose: Provide durable attribution, decision, refusal, approval, effect, and evidence history.
data_flows.tenant_boundary: Tenant-scoped chain; global control events are separately typed and authorized.
data_flows.retention: Legal/security schedule and signed purge/re-anchor procedure required.
data_flows.encryption_in_transit: Authenticated TLS to approved audit destination; live delivery proof required.
data_flows.encryption_at_rest: Off-host signing custody and deployment volume/object-store encryption required.
access: independent auditor with out-of-band public key
data_flows.deletion: Signed retention purge/re-anchor only; no ad-hoc file deletion.

data_flows.purpose: Detect availability, security-control, capacity, quota, cost, queue, and audit-pipeline failures.
data_flows.tenant_boundary: No raw secret labels; global metrics avoid tenant/principal labels; audit chain is authoritative for customer correlation.
data_flows.encryption_in_transit: TLS termination and authenticated scrape required; target TLS remains live-qualified.
data_flows.deletion: Observability-system lifecycle; source application does not assert downstream deletion.

data_flows.purpose: Enforce tenant resource ceilings and monitor spend and saturation.
data_flows.tenant_boundary: Postgres tenant authority; raw tenant/principal identifiers are not general Prometheus labels.
data_flows.retention: Billing and capacity schedule requires legal/finance approval.
data_flows.deletion: Tenant lifecycle subject to legally required billing retention.

data_flows.purpose: Authenticate approved dependencies and encrypt/sign protected state and evidence.
storage: memory only after bounded file read
data_flows.tenant_boundary: Purpose-scoped credentials; metrics credential is distinct from human/operator credentials.
data_flows.retention: Credential lifetime and rotation schedule required; prior keys retained only for bounded verification/overlap needs.
data_flows.encryption_at_rest: Vault/KMS or platform secret encryption; plaintext local audit private key excluded.
data_flows.deletion: Provider revocation plus workload restart/cache clear and verification.

data_flows.purpose: Let admitted read-only tools inspect the customer-mounted workspace.
data_flows.tenant_boundary: One tenant-bound serving profile and read-only tool allowlist; arbitrary command execution disabled.
data_flows.retention: Workspace lifecycle is customer/deployment owned; Lightwork prompt/result retention follows the customer-content schedule.
data_flows.encryption_in_transit: Not applicable for local mount; vLLM transport TLS is required.
data_flows.deletion: Unmount/delete at the customer storage layer plus derived-state lifecycle.

data_flows.purpose: Provide bounded diagnostic and audit evidence to an authorized customer, responder, or auditor.
egress: explicitly authorized customer, responder, or auditor only
data_flows.tenant_boundary: The export tenant must equal the active tenant; exact bounded selectors and private publication are required.
data_flows.retention: Case/evidence retention and legal-hold schedule must be approved for the destination.
data_flows.encryption_in_transit: Approved authenticated transfer channel required after local issuance.
data_flows.encryption_at_rest: Private local permissions plus deployment-approved encrypted case/evidence storage.
data_flows.deletion: Delete from local staging and downstream case/evidence systems only under the approved retention/legal-hold workflow.

excluded_flows: external telemetry export from the application
live_qualification_requirements: Name and approve every actual legal subprocessor, region, purpose, and transfer mechanism.
Approve retention and deletion schedules for every class, including backups, replicas, logs, metrics, audit/WORM, and billing records.
Capture live TLS, encryption-at-rest, access-control, residency, deletion, and restoration evidence.
Execute identity/credential revocation and tenant-erasure residual drills.
Treat any unenumerated runtime data path as a release blocker.
